family.$comment: Fredoka and JetBrains Mono are the playful pair (Adventure, Neon); Instrument Serif and Inter are the premium pair (Confetti). Everything after the first name in each stack is a fallback for before the webfont loads, not another face in the system.

instrument-serif.value: 'Instrument Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Georgia, serif
instrument-serif.comment: refined display serif — one weight (400), so display weight must be regular, never a synthesized bold

snug.comment: serif display — tighter than normal, gentler than tight

loose.comment: uppercase labels and controls — open, but a step under wide
